point.face_source: Materion beryllium data sheet https://hkvxni.files.cmp.optimizely.com/download/c3141b9ea04211ee9a7b2a5d2cb825d4 (S-200F density 1.85 g/cc, E 303 GPa); Brush/Materion Beryllium Guide MB-001 compressive-yield note
point.why_this_row: The order names this QUESTIONABLE row. CNT-yarn is higher and is PROJECTION.

branch.name: shear_crimping
branch.rule: Vc>2 gives Kc=1/Vc and gamma_d=1. Stated global equals crimp at every knockdown. Do not scale it by kd/0.20.

float.ceiling: 014's structural mass is (lift-100)/1.05. This row spends that ceiling. MAINLINE-009's 5 percent margin is not this point.

0.2.note: Vc>2 sets gamma_d to 1. The knockdown does not enter.

0.9.note: Vc>2 sets gamma_d to 1. The knockdown does not enter.

0.1407.note: Vc>2 sets gamma_d to 1. The knockdown does not enter.

honeycomb_coefficient.theoretical_source: MAINLINE-014 names 0.82 from Hemp, as quoted for anti-plane cores in NASA/CR-1999-208994. Those works were not opened here.

nfi.note: Vc is above 2, so Kc is 1/Vc and gamma_d is 1 at every knockdown. Stated global equals crimp. The factor does not scale with kd.
nu is the aluminium case value 0.33. MAINLINE-008 published no beryllium Poisson ratio.

The stated face mode uses compressive yield 283 MPa, which MAINLINE-008 takes from 41 ksi. The same line prints tensile yield 37 ksi. Scaling the face factor by 37/41 leaves it above the crimp pair. QUESTIONABLE.
Hexcel Ec of 76 MPa is the stabilised compressive modulus. MAINLINE-007 says that column is not the continuum modulus of the wrinkling formula. Equation 2.2-14 uses it here because 014 did.

Honeycomb design coefficient 0.33 is CR-1457 equation 2.2-14. The theoretical 0.82 is the value 014 names from Hemp via NASA/CR-1999-208994. Those works were not opened. The least factor does not move, because crimp governs.
Core crush is compressive strength over p/2. Thickness does not enter.
This row uses 014's ceiling, (lift-100)/1.05. Float margin is 0. MAINLINE-009's 5 percent margin is a different point.
CNT-yarn's least factor is higher and the face tag is PROJECTION. It is not this point.
MAINLINE-013 has not filed. Scaled cores are not this row.
Plascore aluminium honeycomb has no Ec. Wrinkling is unscored, so those rows stay out.

rows.source: ord-admiral-rr2-mainline009-p3-pending-011b-1019, reporting the robotics seat's estimate. Not recomputed here.

rows.mode: member bending from the film line load
rows.condition: The mode is absent unless every member is an arc of the sphere.
